newsitem.title: USA: AT&T selects Kodak's George Fisher for board.
newsitem.headline: AT&T selects Kodak's George Fisher for board.

text.p: AT&T Corp. said Thursday it has named Eastman Kodak Co. Chairman and Chief Executive George M.C. Fisher a director-nominee to its board of directors.
Fisher, who has headed Kodak since 1993, will join AT&T's board after the scheduled shareholders' annual meeting in May.
"George will bring a wealth of strategic leadership, business experience and technological insight to the AT&T board," said Robert Allen, AT&T's chairman.

The company said two members will retire from the AT&T board of directors and not stand for reelection. They are Belton Johnson, former owner of Chaparrosa Ranch and chairman of Belton Johnson Interests, and Joseph Williams, retired chairman and chief executive of Warner-Lambert Co.
After the election of Fisher and the two retirements, the company's board would decrease to 10 members, it said.
AT&T's stock fell 50 cents to $35.375 on the New York Stock Exchange at midday.
